claims.text: W Dallas stands in Victory Park, a hub for entertainment, dining and culture.

findings.quote: W Dallas stands in Victory Park, one of the city’s prime hubs for entertainment, dining, culture and much more.

claims.text: The Perot Museum, the Katy Trail and the Arts District are steps away.

findings.quote: Steps away, you’ll find the Perot Museum, Katy Trail, the Arts District and more

claims.text: WET Deck is a rooftop space with skyline views.

findings.quote: Set above the Dallas skyline, this rooftop escape blends sun, skyline views, and a scene that moves from day to night.

claims.text: The spa has a dry sauna, a steam shower and a relaxation lounge.

findings.quote: Detoxify and indulge in self-care in our dry sauna, steam shower, and relaxation lounge with beverages and snacks.

claims.text: The spa offers contrast therapy, moving between the sauna and cold showers.

findings.quote: Move between the dry heat of our sauna and refreshing cold showers to reset your body and mind.

claims.text: The W Suite has skyline views and a private terrace above Victory Park.

findings.quote: Spacious layout, sweeping skyline views, and a private terrace above Victory Park.

claims.text: Suites have floor-to-ceiling windows and Texas-rooted design.

findings.quote: Our suites rise above Uptown Dallas with floor-to-ceiling windows, Texas-rooted design, and Whatever/Whenever service ready when you are.

claims.text: All guest rooms have W signature bedding, smart TVs and Davines bath products.

findings.quote: All guest room feature W Hotels' signature bedding and luxurious amenities such as smart TVs, Davines bath products and more.

claims.text: The Living Room has double-dyed cowhide walls, sculptural furnishings and a chandelier.

findings.quote: Double-dyed cowhide walls, sculptural furnishings, and a perpetual chandelier create an environment that is both bold and immersive.

claims.text: Villa Azur brings Mediterranean glamour.
The hotel is pet-friendly.

findings.quote: Our welcoming spaces make us one of the most stylish pet-friendly hotels in Dallas

claims.text: The W Insider team can help plan and book Dallas activities.

findings.quote: our W Insider team can help guide, book and curate the ultimate Dallas experience.

claims.text: The American Airlines Center arena is across the street from the hotel.

findings.quote: The American Airlines Center—home of the Mavericks and the Stars, as well as major A list concerts—is across the street from our front door.

claims.text: WET Deck includes an outdoor infinity pool on the 16th floor and a pool bar.

findings.quote: WET Deck, including our outdoor infinity pool on the 16th floor and WET Deck Pool Bar.

claims.text: AWAY Spa is on the 16th floor with views of downtown and Victory Park.

findings.quote: Located on the 16th floor with stunning views of downtown and Victory Park, our hotel spa in Dallas is your relaxing urban escape.

claims.text: The Penthouse has a private furnished terrace overlooking the American Airlines Center and the Dallas skyline.

findings.quote: The W Dallas Penthouse delivers a front-row seat to the city, with a private furnished terrace overlooking American Airlines Center and the Dallas skyline.

claims.text: Vinyl DJ sets play in the Living Room, and local DJs play rooftop afternoons by the pool.

findings.quote: Spin into vinyl sets at the Living Room, where curated tracks fuel the moment, or head sky-high for rooftop afternoons with local DJs and sun-struck beats by the pool.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler says the hotel is upscale but anything but traditional in decor and vibe, so it may not suit fans of classic luxury.

findings.quote: The only person I would not recommend this hotel to is one that tends to favor classic luxury. While this is certainly upscale, it is anything but traditional in decor and vibe.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler says the WET Deck pool often has events that draw locals.

findings.quote: it seems like there is always some type of an event going on that attracts locals who are looking for a good spot to day drink.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the urban party atmosphere may not suit all travelers.
